03. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State and informant.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in Special G.R. Case No. 13 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Additional District Judge-cum-PO Special Court under POCSO Act,Sundasrgarh arising out of Lephripara P.S. Case No. 27 of 2023 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n) IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (PA) Act.

3. Taking into account that there is chance of reconciliation, as stated by the learned counsel for the Petitioner as well as informant, this Court directs release of the Petitioner on interim bail for a period of six weeks from the date of his release.
Learned Court in seisin shall fix the terms.

4. Additionally, it is directed that during currency of the interim bail period, the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once a week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the learned Court in seisin.
5. Further, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the victim and/ or her family members.
6. It shall be open to the prosecution to seek variance of this order, in the event there is any threat Kamalesh Sanani @ Sunani vs State Of Odisha ....
